title: The Imperfect Subjunctive: Stem and Endings
goal: Form the imperfect subjunctive from the preterite, with the -ra and -se endings, and use it after a past verb.
grammar: The imperfect subjunctive: stem and endings

items: I can form the imperfect subjunctive from the ellos form of the preterite.
I can form it for irregular verbs such as dijera, leyera and pidiera.
I can use the new words for tasks at work.
